race.description: Rdo Equipment John Deere Mdn Hcp
race.comment: IGOTMYMINDONYOU (4) hasn't been too far away in both outings this campaign and will be ready to peak now third run back. Has placed two of four over this sprint journey and gets some weight relief with the 2kg claim. Rates the testing material against this line-up. CONQUER DAT (3) is drawn to get a gun run in transit from the inside marble and regular rider Savva sticks in the stirrups. Should be right there at the business end. NATION (8) strips fitter second-up from the break and can feature with any luck from the wide draw. POISED TYCOON (7) returned from a spell three weeks ago when he was beaten 5.5 lengths into sixth over 1125m at Grafton. Fitter now and is sure to run well. FLYING SCARLETT (12) best of the rest from the favourable draw.
